systems.system: New data centre presented at NBI Phase V launch

UGA.note: The release gives only the objectives of a new data centre, including service to the private sector; none is stated in service for hire.
No online service, portal or use figure is named.

facts.fact: NITA-U says the first four NBI phases laid 4,387 km of optical fibre connecting 53 district headquarters, 11 major border stations and 1,480 ministries, departments and agencies.

UGA.note: Phase V is launched but no contract or begun works is stated, so no building fact is recorded.

facts.fact: NITA-U says it implemented the NBI as the vehicle for secure data, internet and voice services across government entities, connecting 1,480 ministries, departments and agencies.

UGA.note: District headquarters are named as reached by the network, but no local government office is stated to be connected.
No data centre for hire, ownership or government hosting is stated.
